claim_updates.reason: The frozen preregistration section 8(A) gives mandatory validity gates precedence over scientific outcomes. Those gates are not met by the exact packet evidence: artifacts/raw/ax_captures.jsonl contains 11 records total, comprising ten localhost synthetic pages and one magento_136 record, while the frozen MV4/MV5 contract requires 12 fresh canonical captures across families 136/145/196/222 plus stability evidence; artifacts/derived/canonical_ax_results.json likewise contains only one record. The required twice-executed deterministic family samples are not present in any artifact, and artifacts/derived/shared_webgym_diverse_manifest.json records only the seed rather than S1/S2 results per census, omits the B=2000 CI and threshold-sweep table, and omits 'timestamp' from its expanded-stripping list. The independent audit is REVISE with producer_claim_supported=false, so it cannot authorize VALIDATED status. The audit and artifacts still support a bounded implementation-level finding: tldextract yields one registered_domain ('local.') rather than ten, orthogonal DOM text is 67-107, only one recorded real family meets DOM>=2000, Jaccard gap is 0.0202, and threshold-sweep delta is 0.0. Those facts reject the local relabeling implementation but do not decide whether genuinely independent external hosting or an accessible WebGym census would pass.
